evidence_source: Search Console query+page export, 2026-08-07 to 2026-09-05 (raw/ian-seo/2026-09-10/gsc-query.json), plus a 47-URL site crawl on 2026-09-10 with zero high, medium or low issues.
method: Each factor is scored from 1 to 5 across search_demand, audience_fit, uniqueness, product_path, feasibility, low_maintenance, link_potential and shareability. A total of 25 or more of 40 is a strong candidate. Existing tools are improved before near-duplicates are created.
notes: RadSpeed had no tool_opportunities_file, so the site work queue could never produce a tool item. This ledger closes that measurement gap.
Scores use only measured Search Console evidence for the period above. No estimated demand is used.
Every tool stays decision support with a stated source. No diagnostic-accuracy claim and no patient data.
status is 'ready' only when the live page, the cited source and the Search Console evidence have all been checked. Everything else stays 'verify-first'. disposition records the kind of work.

opportunities.name: Fleischner calculator measurement and prior-comparison upgrade
opportunities.evidence: The Fleischner calculator drew 16 impressions and 0 clicks in the 30-day window: 'fleischner calculator' 9 impressions at position 8.8, 'fleischner criteria calculator' 2 at position 10.0, 'fleischner nodule calculator' 1 at position 11.0 and 'fleischner' 4 at position 72.0. The head terms sit in the 4-20 band. The tool still asks the reader to average the long and short axis and round it by hand, and it cannot compare a prior study, which is the job on most follow-up CT chest reports.
opportunities.next_action: Accept long-axis and short-axis entry, compute the guideline mean diameter with whole-millimetre rounding, and add an optional prior-study comparison that reports the diameter change against the 2 mm growth threshold and the volume change against the 25 per cent threshold. Keep the URL and extend the report line.

opportunities.name: Report template library finder
opportunities.evidence: The library index itself collected 10 impressions across eight distinct template queries at positions 25 to 66, including 'radiology reporting templates', 'rsna reporting templates', 'radiology structured reporting templates', 'ct reporting templates', 'doppler report format', 'wrist ultrasound report template' and 'mri breast report template'. Two of those queries name a study that has no card of its own, so the reader lands on 39 ungrouped cards with no search or filter.
opportunities.next_action: Add a client-side search and modality filter over the 39 templates, with a clear empty state that routes an unmatched study to the closest template.

opportunities.name: TI-RADS calculator depth upgrade
opportunities.evidence: The TI-RADS calculator drew 19 impressions and 0 clicks across 12 queries, but every position sits between 58 and 92 ('tirads calculator' 5 impressions at 81.4, 'tirad score' 3 at 79.3, 'ti-rad' 2 at 62.0). Demand is the highest of any RadSpeed tool, but no query is near page one, so a gain needs materially more depth, not a small edit.
opportunities.next_action: Compare the live page against the top-ranking ACR TI-RADS calculators, then decide whether follow-up interval guidance and a worked example close the gap. Confirm the ACR source version first.

opportunities.name: Impressions drafting tool conversion upgrade
opportunities.evidence: 'impression generator' drew 2 impressions at position 8.0 and 'impressions generator' 1 at position 8.0, with 'rad ai impressions' and 'rad text' far back at 76 and 81. Measured demand is only 5 impressions, so the page ranks well on a small term. The evidence supports a conversion and clarity change, not a ranking push.
opportunities.next_action: Measure the account activation path from the tool before changing it. Do not add features on 5 impressions of evidence.

opportunities.name: Adrenal washout calculator visibility repair
opportunities.evidence: The adrenal calculator drew 6 impressions and 0 clicks across five queries, all at positions 54 to 76 ('adrenal washout radiology' 2 at 69.5, 'adrenal washout' 1 at 54.0, 'adenoma calculator' 1 at 76.0). The arithmetic is already correct, so the gap is discovery and internal linking rather than function.
opportunities.next_action: Check its internal links from the CT abdomen templates and the calculator hub before any change to the tool itself.
